texts.Territory_Error_Busy: A territory run is already queued or running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
texts.Territory_Error_NoJob: Only an Assign run can be undone, and this run has no Data job.
texts.Territory_Error_NothingToRun: No active rule of an active territory: add or turn on a rule, then run again.
texts.Territory_Error_Rule: Rule {0} cannot run: {1} Fix or turn off the rule, then run again.
texts.Territory_Error_TooManyRules: {0} have more than {1} active rules. Turn some off, or merge them, then run again.
texts.Territory_Log_Finished: Territory run finished: {0} records checked, {1} moved, {2} refused.
texts.Territory_Page_AssignConfirm: Assign moves every matching record into its territory and, where the territory routes owners, changes its owner. It runs as you, in the background, as one data job you can undo. Continue?
texts.Territory_Page_DeleteConfirm: Delete {0}? This cannot be undone here; records keep the territory they have.
texts.Territory_Page_FixConditions: Fix the conditions marked in the rule, then save again.
texts.Territory_Page_Intro: Put people, households and organizations into territories by rules, and give them owners by territory, in turn or by capacity. Preview first: it changes nothing.
texts.Territory_Page_NoMembers: No members. Round Robin and Capacity need at least one.
texts.Territory_Page_NoRules: No rules: this territory gets no records.
texts.Territory_Page_NoRuns: No runs yet. Press Preview to see what Assign would do.
texts.Territory_Page_NoTerritories: No territories yet. Press New Territory to add one.
texts.Territory_Page_Running: A run is queued or running. Press Refresh to see its result.
texts.Territory_Page_TooManyRules: {0} have more than {1} active rules, so a run will be refused. Turn some off or merge them.
texts.Territory_Page_UndoConfirm: Undo puts back each record's territory and owner, except where someone has changed them since. Continue?
texts.Territory_Page_Undoing: The undo is running. Press Refresh to see the run's job marked Undone.
